scenes.longevidad: Article: We live longer than our grandparents; caring today makes room for future life. Show a simple gardening workbench with a well-used pair of adult gardening gloves beside a newer smaller adult pair, a modest watering can, one healthy mature potted herb and one small seedling in a terracotta pot. A quiet intergenerational still life about care carried forward. Keep these five main objects, generous breathing room, no people, no clocks, no age numbers or guarantee of longevity. Objects form a natural left-to-right rhythm, central seedling important. Warm light from upper left, believable contact shadows and scale.
scenes.presupuesto: Article: an unexpected health expense disrupts a family's budget. A tabletop still life with three modest household budgeting envelopes with plain colored tabs, a closed everyday wallet, a house key, and an unexpectedly long blank receipt unfolding diagonally across and displacing the tidy arrangement. A few generic unmarked coins, no identifiable currency or amounts. Make the interruption legible, calm rather than alarmist; no broken piggy bank, no medical emergency, no logos, no labels, no readable receipt text. Natural consistent scale and upper-left light.
scenes.nutricion: Article: distinguishing nutrition evidence from social-media myths. One real pear rests centrally beside a smartphone on a table; several overlapping small message/post cards surround the phone, each containing a tiny pear image presented in different emphatic frames. A modest magnifying glass rests beside the real pear and reveals its skin texture naturally. The visual idea is examining the real thing amid repetitive noisy claims, NOT labelling any food good or bad. No people, no claims, no words, no checkmarks or crosses, no red warning icons. Keep the pear, phone, cards and magnifying glass as the recognizable core. Believable object scale, shadows from upper left.

styles.facetada: FACETED EDITORIAL ILLUSTRATION: build volume through broad asymmetric angular planes of color, crisp polygonal transitions, restrained texture, sophisticated geometric composition. No outlines, no photographic rendering, no cut-paper edges. Muted teal, sage, deep navy, cream and small terracotta accents. Preserve a warm handmade editorial feel rather than shiny 3D.
styles.collage: EDITORIAL MIXED-MEDIA COLLAGE: conspicuously hand-cut and torn paper shapes mixed with selective photographic object fragments, visible layered edges, rough fiber paper and varied printed textures, asymmetrical layout with bold negative space. This must unmistakably look like a designed physical collage, not smooth faceted painting and not deep embossed 3D. Cream paper, navy, teal, sage and mustard accents. No newspaper letters or text.
styles.gouache: HAND-PAINTED GOUACHE: opaque matte paint, visible imperfect brush strokes and pigment variation, soft organic contours, lively painterly edges, warm light with carefully observed forms. Airy cream ground, sage, teal, navy, restrained terracotta. No hard polygonal faceting, no digital gradients, no collage, no ink hatching. An expressive editorial still-life painting.
styles.serigrafia: TWO-INK SCREENPRINT: only deep navy and muted teal ink on warm ivory paper; large graphic silhouettes, intentional halftone dots, slight organic ink-edge irregularities and controlled ink overlap. Strong flat poster-like design, sparing details, powerful negative space. Absolutely no painterly shaded volumes, photography, 3D, collage or multicolor palette. No typography.
styles.foto_objetos: CONCEPTUAL STILL-LIFE PHOTOGRAPH: a carefully art-directed real-material studio tabletop, tactile real paper, real wood and ceramic, naturally imperfect objects, soft window light from upper left, subtle physically consistent shadows, believable lens perspective. Restrained warm ivory, muted teal and sage setting. Premium editorial photographic lighting; no CGI appearance, no plastic toy look, no illustration, no people. The objects are a staged visual metaphor, not documentary evidence.
